_notes: Thresholds harness.py qualify applies to every phone. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
harness_min_sdk 23: Android 6.0, the Galaxy S5's last release; the binaries target API 23.
product_min_sdk 29 and product_abis arm64-v8a: the XREAL SDK floor (Android 10, 64-bit ARM only); PROPOSED, pending a ruling.
encode/decode_allowance_us 250: the simulator's assumed per-message L6 encode and decode times (encodeUs, decodeUs).
max_codec_core_pct: the L6 codec's share of one core at the ICD load in 'load' (7 peers at 15 Hz state, 3 Hz summaries, 1 input/s with 3 copies, the 5 items/s catch-up).
multicast_min_share: L4; each phone must hear, and be heard by, at least this share of its peers' frames.
